comparison.objective: Install and secure a load-bearing DGX rack rail; record rinses teeth and evacuates fluid.
comparison.physical_skill: Long-part support, spring-prong latching, telescoping alignment, and screw fastening versus coordinated irrigation/suction trajectories.
comparison.success_condition: Rail must engage four post holes at one rack unit, self-support, and use correct screw holes; record measures coverage, fluid recovery/spill, tool return, and a 1 s hold.
comparison.reason: Objectives, manipulated physics, and terminal checks are unrelated. Candidate force and damage thresholds remain unspecified, but that omission does not suggest duplication.
